title: Qualify the F8 exit candidate on Windows
requires: Physical Windows GTX 1080 with CUDA and D3D12
scope: Qualify only the F8-93 replacement candidate on the registered Windows GTX 1080 CUDA and D3D12 targets. Execute the complete installed public SDK and Gallery contract for both adapters. Preserve candidate-v10 history, the PEG PAINT F9-09 routing and the F9 timing deferral.
acceptance: Build, package, relocate and install the exact frozen source for both CUDA and D3D12; bind source, binary, driver, SDK, shortcut and Gallery identities.

Pass 49 capability obligations, 30 public cases, 12 physical scenarios, lifecycle/recovery assertions, fixed-work checks and five negative controls in plain and validation modes on each applicable adapter.
Complete every frozen workload with declared counts, 600 warmup and 7200 retained measured ticks, zero failed ticks and all stalls preserved. Classify timing separately under F9-07/F9-08.
Verify ordinary API 0.3 and installed Gallery use the sole schedule with no fallback or profile selection. Retain PEG PAINT as failed F9-09 scene debt unless separately repaired and reviewed.
Publish independent CUDA/D3D12 verdicts and raw artifacts; neither row may substitute for the other.
Publish current revisioned capability evidence suitable for the generated public qualification index; candidate-suite reports may not remain an undocumented substitute.
